issues.title: Context Truncation of Per-Artifact Specs
issues.why: The module defines 50+ scripts but delegates their logic to external files (01-*.md, etc.) which are truncated in this context. A mediocre AI cannot implement the logic for scripts 10-79.
issues.fix: Provide the full content of the NN-*.md files or consolidate core logic for the most critical scripts into the overview.

issues.fix: In-line the normative requirements from the referenced lessons or provide the lesson-registry file.

issues.title: Ambiguous Concurrency Implementation
